english.title: To procure formation of a civil partnership make a false section 80(2) declaration / give a false notice / certificate
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) for the purpose of procuring the formation of a

(A)_[civil partnership between **(..SPECIFY THE NAMES..),]_
(B)_[civil partnership schedule under Chapter 1 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004,]_
(C)_[Registrar General's licence under Chapter 1 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004,]_
(D)_[document required by an Order in Council under section 210 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004 as an authority for two people to register as civil partners of each other,]_
(E)_[document required by an Order in Council under section 211 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004 as an authority for two people to register as civil partners of each other,]_
(F)_[certificate of no impediment under section 240 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004,]_

(G)_[made a declaration required under Part 2 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004,]_
(H)_[made a declaration required under Part 5 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004,]_
(I)_[signed a declaration required under Part 2 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004,]_
(J)_[signed a declaration required under Part 5 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004,]_
(K)_[gave a notice so required,]_
(L)_[gave a certificate so required,]_

knowing that the

(M)_[declaration]_
(N)_[notice]_
(O)_[certificate]_

was false
english.legislation: Contrary to section 80(1)(a) and 80(3) of the Civil Partnership Act 2004.
